name: echo gpu fan
description: Proposal, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x), the creature standing in front of a big grey square case fan that runs one duty cycle: the blades stand still and it blinks, then the fan spins up with a darker smear growing behind each blade while the draught bends the antenna back to the left, at full speed the hole becomes a grey blur disc with pale streak arcs turning in it, the antenna lies back and flutters, the eyes squint against the wind and warm shimmer lines rise over its head, carried left by the draught, then it spins down, the heat thins out, the eyes open, and when the blades stop the antenna springs past upright, settles and pings; judge whether the spin up and the blur read as speed rather than a grey plate, whether the bent antenna reads as wind, and whether it is still this creature.
